SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sku) FROM store.products) as total_products,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments.customer_complaints 
     WHERE complaint_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND complaint_ts < '2026-07-01' 
     AND kind ILIKE '%payment%') as payment_complaints,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits 
     WHERE audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01' 
     AND status = 'empty') as empty_shelves;

SELECT 
    SUM(line_amount) as total_revenue,
    (SELECT SUM(p.cost_inr * pl.qty) 
     FROM store.pos_lines pl 
     JOIN store.products p ON pl.sku_scanned = p.sku 
     WHERE pl.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND pl.bill_ts < '2026-07-01') as total_cost
FROM store.pos_lines 
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT 
    sku_scanned, 
    SUM(qty) as total_qty, 
    AVG(unit_price) as avg_price
FROM store.pos_lines 
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY sku_scanned;
